title: A linear subspace is determined by its intersection with a ball centred at one of its points
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let Q₁, Q₂ be linear subspaces of ℝ^P, let x ∈ Q₁ and t > 0. If Q₁ ∩ B_t(x) = Q₂ ∩ B_t(x) (open balls), then Q₁ = Q₂.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q₁ Q₂ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), x ∈ Q₁ → 0 < t → (Q₁ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x t = (Q₂ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x t → Q₁ = Q₂
